name: poney
description: Poney: an open format for describing software, and a studio for exploring it.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/layout && tsc -p packages/react && tsc -p packages/render && tsc -p packages/ext-ownership && tsc -p packages/ext-security && tsc -p packages/examples && tsc -p packages/agent && tsc -p apps/studio
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hattoriai/poney-core -w @hattoriai/poney-layout -w @hattoriai/poney-react -w @hattoriai/poney-render -w @hattoriai/poney-ext-ownership -w @hattoriai/poney-ext-security && npm run build -w @hattoriai/poney-studio && npm run build -w @hattoriai/poney
